description:
Lua in templates: {% raw %}`{% lua %}`{% endraw %} blocks and imported `.lua` modules in `query.sql` and
`query.transform`. Runs Lua, so it asks for trust first. See
`:help dbdash-template-lua`.

query.transform:
{% import 'modules/helpers.lua' as h %}
-- Lua: mark weekends and add a running total; the source column comes from the same
-- helper module, rendered into this code by the template.
local source, out, total = "{{ h.label('visits') }}", {}, 0
for _, r in ipairs(rs.rows) do
  total = total + r[2]
  out[#out + 1] = { day = r[1]:sub(6), visits = r[2], total = total,
                    note = r[3] == 1 and "weekend" or "", source = source }
end
out.columns = { "day", "visits", "total", "note", "source" }
return out

show.title: Visits (Lua in templates)
show.description:
Rows made by a Lua module (`modules/helpers.lua`), a column written by a {% raw %}`{% lua %}`{% endraw %}
block, and a transform that adds a running total.
